actions.name: idle
actions.description: Do nothing this tick. Rest or wait in place.

actions.name: move
actions.description: Move toward a destination or in a direction.

actions.name: speak
actions.description: Say something aloud — to a nearby agent, a group, or the world.

actions.name: interact
actions.description: Interact with a nearby object or agent.

actions.name: patrol
actions.description: Move to a named waypoint on the patrol route.

actions.name: alert
actions.description: Raise an alarm about a nearby threat.

actions.name: detain
actions.description: Attempt to detain a suspicious target agent.

actions.name: trade
actions.description: Offer or accept a trade with a nearby agent.

actions.name: greet
actions.description: Greet a nearby agent to build social rapport.

actions.name: follow
actions.description: Follow a target agent across the scene.
